name: credit-packs
title: Credit packs
description: One-off credit packs with the price per credit and the saving against the smallest pack worked out from your numbers, and one pack marked best value.
docs: Pass the packs (an id, credits, price in whole units and an optional label, smallest first), onSelect, and the currency and locale prices are written in. The saving and the best value badge are worked out from the packs, never typed in: the smallest pack is the standard rate, every other pack shows what it saves per credit against it, rounded down so the claim is never larger than the truth, and the badge goes to the cheapest credit, but only when that is cheaper than the smallest pack. Pass bestValue with an id to choose another pack, or null for no badge. The packs are a radio group (arrow keys move and choose, one tab stop) with the best value pack chosen at the start, or the one in defaultValue; value and onValueChange make it controlled. The button hands the chosen pack to onSelect and the section takes no payment itself. expiry is the rule buyers ask about first and is said beside the button as a plain sentence, so Credits never expire and Credits are valid for 12 months are written alike. Under 672px every pack is a compact row with the price on the right; from there the packs are cards that share their rows through a subgrid, so credits, prices and savings line up, and the columns follow the count so no card is left alone in a row. labels translates every fixed word.
